family: Advanced Adaptive Large Neighborhood Search Components

entries.name: Pair-coupled segmented roulette selection
entries.description: Learns one adaptive weight per destroy/repair pair instead of two independent operator weights.

entries.name: Alpha-UCB operator-pair selection
entries.description: Treats each destroy/repair pair as a bandit action and balances average reward against an exploration bonus.

entries.name: Threshold Accepting adapter
entries.description: Reuses the platform's sense-aware ThresholdAcceptancePolicy through the LNS/ALNS acceptance contract.

entries.name: Record-to-Record Travel adapter
entries.description: Reuses the platform's best-record deviation acceptance through the LNS/ALNS acceptance contract.

entries.name: Contextual multi-armed-bandit selection
entries.description: Conditions pair selection on a state-context vector rather than reward history alone.
entries.formula: Deferred until the platform has a stable generic context-vector contract for arbitrary solution representations.

entries.name: Scheduled Great Deluge adapter
entries.description: Requires an explicit run-local level-advance hook because Great Deluge acceptance carries evolving water-level state.
entries.formula: Deferred rather than hiding mutable schedule state inside a reusable acceptance object.
